title: NFL walk-forward model vs listed market prices (paper research only)
note: Written before any model code existed and before any test-season result was computed. wf.py reads every setting below from this file. Any later change must be logged under deviations with time and reason; test-season results may not motivate a change.

data.games_used_for_betting: rows with both scores present and game_type in REG, WC, DIV, CON, SB
data.data_quality_rows: kept exactly as published; rows where spread sign disagrees with the moneyline favorite (|spread_line| >= 1.5 and the moneyline favorite is the other team) are counted and a sensitivity run excluding them is reported

as_of_rule: Features for game g use only results of games whose gameday is strictly earlier than g's gameday. Games on the same date never see each other's results. Pre-game fields of g itself allowed: spread_line, total_line, moneylines and juice for g, away_rest, home_rest, div_game, location (Neutral vs Home), roof == 'dome'. Not allowed: scores, result, total, overtime, temp, wind, roof open/closed state, QB names.

elo.tie_update: result 0.5, multiplier ln(1)=0, so no change
elo.season_regression: rating = 1505 + (2/3) * (rating - 1505) before each team's first game of a new season
elo.source: FiveThirtyEight NFL Elo, as described by secondary replications; original page offline (see WALKFORWARD_RESULT.md)

points.kind: exponentially weighted points scored (off) and allowed (def) per team

models.fit: logistic regression with L2 penalty, Newton-Raphson, intercept not penalized

win.target: home team wins (ties dropped from fit)
win.fit_rows: games with valid moneylines on both sides, seasons 2006..S-1

cover.target: home covers: result > spread_line (pushes dropped from fit)
cover.fit_rows: games with spread_line, seasons 2002..S-1 (1999-2001 are rating burn-in)

over.target: over: total > total_line (pushes dropped from fit)

walk_forward.refit: once per test season, on seasons strictly earlier than the test season only
walk_forward.2026: season to date: games with scores in the file (last scored gameday 2026-11-12)

pricing.price_used: the listed American odds for that side in games.csv (moneyline, spread juice or total juice)
pricing.missing_or_invalid_juice: spread/total: assume -110 for that side and flag the bet price_assumed=true; moneyline: no bet (cannot assume a moneyline). Invalid means |odds| < 100 or not a number.
pricing.fair_probability: multiplicative (proportional) devig of the two listed sides: p_i = q_i / (q_home + q_away), q = implied probability
pricing.payout: 1 unit risked per bet; win pays american profit (odds/100 if positive, 100/|odds| if negative); push returns 0; loss -1

stress.minus_10_cents: every price 10 cents worse on the American cents scale (-110 -> -120, +150 -> +140, +105 -> -105)
stress.minus_half_point: spread and total line 0.5 point worse for the side bet; moneyline unchanged

selection.primary_rule: bet a side when model probability minus market fair probability for that side >= 0.03 (at most one side per market per game)
selection.note: Selection uses the fair-probability edge at the listed price; stress results reuse the same bets, priced worse. No threshold is chosen from test results.

metrics.calibration_all_games: log-loss and Brier of model vs market fair probability on every test game with valid prices (pushes and ties dropped)
metrics.bootstrap: block bootstrap by (season, week), 2000 resamples, seed 20261115, 95% percentile CI for pooled ROI and for pooled log-loss difference (model minus market)
metrics.pooled_test_seasons: 2012-2025 completed seasons; 2026 reported separately and also in an all-seasons row

verdict_rule: An out-of-sample edge is claimed only if, for a market, the pooled 2012-2025 ROI at listed prices has a bootstrap 95% CI entirely above 0 AND model log-loss beats the market (CI of difference entirely below 0). With 3 markets tested, a lone marginal pass is reported as not established. Otherwise verdict: no demonstrated edge.

deviations.change: Ratings follow franchises across relocations: STL->LA, SD->LAC, OAK->LV (team codes in games.csv change on relocation; without this the relocated team would restart at 1505).
deviations.reason: implementation detail found while reading team codes; not motivated by any result

deviations.change: The data-quality sensitivity run also excludes the three games named in nfldata GitHub issue #34 (2021_15_NE_IND, 2021_17_CLE_PIT, 2023_02_IND_HOU; reported spread sign flips). Primary run keeps all rows as published.
deviations.reason: third-party data-quality report found during provenance check; not motivated by any result
